items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: every time I do the big band thing I have fifteen men, I have six brass, five saxes and three rhythm, four rhythm sometimes when I add a guitar, and Sam comes out and does a scat thing that he and I play flute and clarinet.

ctx.x: As a matter of fact we’re doing — every time I do the big band thing I have fifteen men, I have six brass, five saxes and three rhythm, four rhythm sometimes when I add a guitar, and Sam comes out and does a scat thing that he and I play flute and clarinet.
I’m curious if you two were always good buddies?

items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I was up there playing tenor with him and a few other people, I think my brother up there but he played vibes

ctx.x: And the next time they’ll see you and you’ll just be playing flute.

Hey this guy’s versatile. I played in Cambria with Charlie Shumack, there’s a club up there, so I was up there playing tenor with him and a few other people, I think my brother up there but he played vibes and I get on the piano for some things and the people were applauding when I played the solos, so I says hey I must be doing pretty good.
